92109-accept.name: Odd Child
92109-accept.text:
Erm... 'Ello, mister. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
92109-accept.title: My First Alchemy Set

92109-complete.name: Odd Child
92109-complete.text:
Oh my gosh! Look at these! Did you pick the herbs yourself?

Wow, thanks mister, I am going to see what I can make with these right now! Do you want to watch?
92109-complete.title: My First Alchemy Set

92109-progress.name: Odd Child
92109-progress.text: 'Ello again! Did you bring back alchemy stuff?
92109-progress.title: My First Alchemy Set

92110-accept.name: Odd Child
92110-accept.text:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
92110-accept.title: My First Real Potion

98025-accept.name: Unknown
98025-accept.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025-accept.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-complete.text:
It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her descent into madness.

Regardless, thank you for your service today, $c. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.
98025-complete.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings, $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea
